relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: Moye et al. found that the arachidonic acid enriched at the injury site was converted locally into prostanoids including PGE2 via COX-2–expressing myeloid cells.

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: this PGE2 acted on local connective tissue progenitors to induce endochondral ossification

relationships.subject: Celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: treating the mouse HO model with the COX-2–specific inhibitor celecoxib attenuated HO development

relationships.subject: Omega-6 fatty acids
relationships.evidence_quote: These omega-6 fatty acids played a causal role in driving HO

key_findings: Dietary omega-6 lipids are converted to PGE2 via COX-2 at the injury site, driving heterotopic ossification.
Celecoxib reduced HO in mice and in obese arthroplasty patients.
